question:
If '+' means '−', '−' means '×', '×' means '÷', '÷' means '+', then what will be the correct answer of the following relation?

(6 - 20 ÷ 24) × 8 + 6 = ?
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cd485bd80bc9adbdfa61452654abee82eaf58531efe15704150177632530fa8.png] 

Given the equation: (6 - 20 ÷ 24) × 8 + 6 = ?

After replacing the signs from left to right and using the BODMAS rule,

= (6 × 20 + 24) ÷ 8 - 6 

= (120 + 24) ÷ 8 - 6 

= (144) ÷ 8 - 6

= 18 - 6

= 12

Hence, the correct answer is "12".
